mods.name: Sound / Recording
mods.author: TEO-F
mods.summary: Choose16-bit or24-bit stereo WAV recording at44.1 kHz.
mods.description:
Choose 16-bit or 24-bit stereo PCM WAV recording at 44.1 kHz. Open Installed > Sound / Recording and tap the desired depth; the orange button shows your selection. With the browse knob, turn to focus and press to confirm. Default: 16-bit. The choice is saved and applies to the next recording; an open file is unchanged. Two short real-device recordings verified. Public beta: long recordings, automatic splits and storage-error recovery remain unverified. Exact firmware ep147-9e9454e357389ece; core API >=1.2.3.

24-bit recording retains nonzero lower sample bits in the checked file; it is not simply 16-bit audio padded with zeros. This does not prove 24 effective bits, bit-perfect source fidelity or audible improvement, and cannot restore information lost earlier in the audio path.

Format: uncompressed stereo WAV (PCM). Sample rate: fixed 44.1 kHz. No 48/96 kHz or 32-bit modes. The page displays the next-recording preference, not a measurement of the currently open writer. 24-bit audio uses about 50% more storage than 16-bit.

To disable: stop and finalize recording, stop playback, then Disable this mod and Reload. Selecting 16-bit alone does not unload the hook. Use a separate test USB before relying on the beta for a performance. Installation and offline disable instructions are in the repository README.
